why_trail.why: GATE_PROTOCOL.md is frozen (SPLIT_HASH f1725bd81cd3eefa): LOWO over the 16-weekend 2023 split, two arms (clock parameter-free / learned fp_representativeness-fitted), primary=apex_pace-style mass-free grip capability read on divergent-tercile cases, secondary=power/weight matched-sigma-or-confounded, paired bootstrap (10k) significance, emergence guard against session-identity smuggling, sandbagging demo direction frozen (learned<clock). Real seams (fp_representativeness/fp_lap_latent/apex_extract/capability) confirmed importable and matching the handoff's cited signatures -- build_gate_observations will call fp_representativeness.observation_features/observation_weight directly (reuse, not reinvent), and apex_pace/apex_extract stay behind the injectable extractor seam since G6 uses synthetic fixtures only. Plan m1-m7 will build fp_gate.py incrementally (seam -> fit/LOWO/leakage -> divergent/emergence/sandbag -> the two load-bearing fixtures -> secondary channel -> thin CLI -> evidence).

fp_gate.py created: RawFpObservation/RawQTarget/GateExtractor Protocol (the injectable seam), GateObservation/WeekendGateData, build_gate_observations (reuses fp_representativeness.observation_features verbatim, computes session_max_track_evolution from OTHER FP observations only -- no Q leakage), clock_weight (parameter-free exp decay on hours_to_q, CLOCK_DECAY_HOURS=24.0) and learned_weight (delegates to fp_representativeness.observation_weight verbatim). 11/11 new tests green.

fp_gate.py gained _predict_car_capability (weighted-mean aggregate, value_attr-generic for channel reuse), fit_weight_params (Nelder-Mead over pooled train-weekend MSE, signature accepts ONLY train_weekends -- leakage guard F6 by construction, no other data path), _weekend_metric (Spearman + centred RMSE per GATE_PROTOCOL sec 4), FoldResult/LowoResult + run_lowo (LEAVE-ONE-WEEKEND-OUT, held-out weekend never passed to fit_fn), BootstrapResult + paired_bootstrap (10k-default paired bootstrap, F7, deterministic per-seed numpy Generator). 10/10 new tests green including two LEAKAGE tests (direct fit_weight_params call and through run_lowo's own fold loop) proving shuffling a held-out weekend's Q targets cannot change that fold's fitted params.

fp_gate.py gained DivergentReadResult+divergent_case_read (top-tercile |w_learned-w_clock| re-read per fold's OWN fitted params, INCONCLUSIVE when the tercile boundary itself is near-zero OR every fold is too sparse to compute a metric -- corrected from an earlier frac-of-total heuristic that could never actually trigger since a quantile-based tercile split is always ~1/3 by construction; the real degeneracy signal is the boundary VALUE, not the count), EmergenceResult+emergence_audit (push>longrun at identical track_evolution + non-track-feature range > track-evolution-only range), SandbagResult+sandbagging_demo (data-defined largest FP-best-to-Q jump car-weekend, asserts mean(learned)<mean(clock)), GateVerdict+evaluate_gate (combines overall paired-bootstrap with the divergent-case confirmation; a thin divergent set forces INCONCLUSIVE regardless of the overall bootstrap, per protocol sec 6 'not a pass'). 8/8 new tests green; full accumulated suite 29/29 green.

POSITIVE (push=TRUE ranking far-clock/low-fuel/soft, long_run=REVERSED ranking near-clock/high-fuel/hard, genuinely differing features so the fit legitimately learns to favor push) now yields PASS end-to-end. NULL (identical features everywhere so learned_weight is a PROVABLE CONSTANT immune to any fit outcome; only clock-distance carries real information, near=true near-dominant 1x vs far=reversed 2x-weighted) yields HONEST_NULL. Root-caused and fixed a real scale-mismatch bug along the way: divergent_case_read now min-max normalizes both arms' weights over the pooled observation set before differencing (clock's unbounded exp-decay and learned's bounded logistic live on different native scales; comparing raw differences let whichever arm had the wider range at its extreme monopolize the tercile split into a degenerate same-prediction group). Also added L2 shrinkage (DEFAULT_L2_PENALTY=1e-3, toward ) to fit_weight_params -- unconstrained Nelder-Mead was saturating coefficients toward the sigmoid's asymptote on this clean/small dataset. Full accumulated suite 31/31 green (all m1-m4 tests together, including the earlier LOWO/leakage/divergent/emergence/sandbag tests, confirming these two fixes didn't regress anything).

fp_gate.py gained SecondaryGateResult and secondary_power_gate: quantile-bins pooled FP observations by fp_mass_sigma_kg into matched strata and reruns run_lowo/paired_bootstrap generalized via value_attr=power_value/target_attr=q_power_target within each bin; returns CONFOUNDED_NOT_EVIDENTIAL (never silently evaluated) when sigma has no material spread or no bin survives with 2+ weekends; PASS requires every surviving bin to favor learned. Fixed a generator-expression syntax bug during implementation (conditional-inside-generator needs the ternary before the loop clauses, not after). 3/3 new tests green (constant-sigma confounded path, real-spread evaluated path, min_distinct_sigma override forcing confounded). Full accumulated suite 34/34 green.
